_metadata.description: Operational requirements for Template Manager's accountable ownership of Vrooli template handling.

requirements.title: Template Registry Store
requirements.description: Persist scenario, design-kit, and resource-template records with kind, id, version, manifest metadata, provenance hashes, and discoverable API/CLI read surfaces.

validation.notes: Repository and service tests round-trip seeded template records through migration-owned SQLite storage.
CLI manifest commands list/show registry records through generated Connect clients.

requirements.title: Validation Runs And Debt Ledger
requirements.description: Record template validation runs, drift snapshots, version lag, and stable deduplicated debt entries so template quality trends persist after each run.

validation.notes: Fake-runner tests cover parse, persist, deduplicate, and update behavior for validation findings.
Live shallow and deep validation runs are persisted and queryable through API and CLI; deep execution records terminal Test Genie phase results.

requirements.title: Test Genie Templates Phase Provider
requirements.description: Expose scenario-validation/v1 ValidateScenario plus PreviewFix/ApplyFix for missing generation provenance, keeping validation static and acyclic.

validation.notes: Provider descriptor and live probe pass the Phase Capability Contract.
Preview and apply modes stamp adopted generation provenance idempotently.

requirements.title: Orientation Guidance Surface
requirements.description: Return the next incomplete orientation gate, its checks, contract text, and remediation pointers for any pre-finalize scenario.

validation.notes: Guidance service tests select the correct next gate and finalized state from fixtures.
CLI returns structured gate data without requiring agents to read START-HERE prose.

requirements.title: Factory Documentation Service
requirements.description: Own and index factory docs covering maintenance, generation contract, validation modes, drift, cleanup, migration, and debt workflows.

validation.notes: search-hub queries return Template Manager factory docs and debt entries from the scenario provider.

requirements.title: Dashboard And Measures
requirements.description: Render fleet standing, validation history, debt trends, and template registry data in the UI while exposing matching measures through /measures and typed CLI/API surfaces.

validation.notes: UI tests cover loading, empty, error, a11y, and data-rendering states for the dashboard overview plus the paginated template/run/debt list routes and the template, run, and debt-entry detail views reached through them.
Measures declarations and typed MeasuresService return identical computed values.

requirements.title: Recurring Deep Validate Monitor
requirements.description: Run serialized scheduled deep validation for registered templates, persist scheduler-attributed results, and expose monitor status through API, CLI, and UI.

validation.notes: Monitor tests cover scheduler attribution and active-template selection; a scheduler-attributed deep run is persisted through the production lifecycle.

requirements.title: Scenario Template And Design Cutover
requirements.description: Move scenario-template and design-kit lifecycle handling into Template Manager API/CLI, carry existing engine tests, and delete old vrooli command/proto owners.

validation.notes: Throwaway scenario lifecycle succeeds entirely through Template Manager commands.
Moved generation, orientation, detemplate, design, hash, and drift suites pass in their new home.

requirements.title: Resource Template Cutover
requirements.description: Move resource-template handling into Template Manager, expose resource-template API/CLI commands, and unify duplicate substitution/text-detection engines.

validation.notes: Resource template tests pass and repo grep proves only one renderTemplateString implementation remains.

requirements.title: Orientation Gate Stewardship
requirements.description: Own the orientation gate schema, shared check vocabulary, and evaluation engine while templates retain declarative per-template gate data. The engine provides a content_adapted check kind and auto-derives it from declared text_absent markers, measuring placeholder-aware net-new divergence from the template source (JSON threshold 1, prose 3) so green orientation certifies real adaptation rather than shipped files.

validation.notes: Unit tests cover both directions (fail-on-boilerplate, fail-on-marker-deletion-gaming, pass-on-real-content) plus derivation, thresholds, and template-source skip. Live proof: a fresh generated scenario shows content-quality gates incomplete while genuinely oriented content advances them, with zero fleet regressions across scenarios/*.
